request.subject: UNIT:CANDY:JUGGERNAUT

layers.text: Recolour and change nothing else: every mint green crystal chunk of the golem becomes a block of dark chocolate #4a2412, with lighter milk chocolate #8a5330 facets and small cream highlights; the brown bands at its joints become bright caramel gold #e0a040, dripping; its face becomes pale cream #fff1d0, with dark eyes; the crest on its head is golden toffee crystal. No green is left. Keep every shape, the pose, thick black outline and style the same, on a transparent background.
